input.overview: Super Flipp is a purely mechanical marble game attached to a gumball vendor. Insert a coin and turn the knob: one gumball vends immediately while a marble moves to the shooter. Keep the marble away from the left 0 hole, use the right 50 hole to return it to the shooter for another attempt, and send it into the upper 100 hole to win the marble.
input.simpleOverview: In Super Flipp, insert a coin and turn the knob to vend a gumball and load a marble at the shooter. Avoid the left 0 hole, which loses the marble. The right 50 hole sends it back to the shooter for another attempt, while the upper 100 hole awards the marble to the player.
input.summary: The only progression is physical: preserve the marble through the right 50 return hole and aim the next plunge or flipper contact toward the upper 100 award hole. The left 0 hole ends the attempt.

steps.text: Insert a coin and turn the knob; collect the vended gumball and use the shooter to launch the marble.
Use the two mechanical flippers to keep the marble away from the left 0 hole.
Aim for the right 50 hole when you need another launch; it returns the marble to the shooter.
Aim for the upper 100 hole to award the marble and finish the successful route.

alternatives.title: Return-and-retry
alternatives.when: Use this when the upper 100 hole is not available from the current rebound.

steps.text: Guide the marble into the right 50 hole.
Set up the shooter for another launch.
Use the new launch to attack the upper 100 hole.
Use the right 50 hole to preserve the marble and reset at the shooter.
Land in the upper 100 hole to win the marble.

machineSetup: Confirm that the coin-and-knob cycle vends one gumball and transfers one marble to the shooter without binding.
Test both flippers, the left 0 drain, the right 50 return path, the upper 100 award path, and the marble payout before play.
